g.text: One Index Answers the Whole System's Core Query
job_definitions is small and hot; job_runs is huge and sharded by job_id, not by shard
job_definitions is sharded by shard (matches how leader election partitions scanning work);
job_runs is sharded by job_id instead, because run-history reads are scoped per job, not per shard -- the two tables scale on different axes.
